thread: maya: Quick design Q — for the new Bulk Edit form (configs) do we keep inline field errors or switch to a top-level error summary with anchors? also debating required-marker UX (asterisk vs explicit) and delete-confirm copy/flow. thoughts? liam: For bulk actions I lean summary + anchors. users often have to scroll to find the bad rows. inline is great for live validation though. :+1: sophia: Accessibility note: if we use a summary, focus must move to it and it should be announced (role=alert / aria-live). anchors should provide clear context (e.g., "Row 3: missing name"). rahul: Could we do both? summary for submit-time errors and inline for per-field realtime feedback. summary lists the errors with links to the row/field. keeps discoverability high. maya: agree both seems safe. question on required markers — should we show asterisks in table column headers? too noisy? liam: asterisk is common but ambiguous on its own. in compact table view maybe show asterisk + a footer legend "* required". avoids cluttering labels. sophia: WCAG: an asterisk alone isn't great for screen readers. if we keep asterisks, also include text for SRs, e.g., required or aria-label on the field. maya: good call. last thing — delete selected copy. current modal says: "Delete X items? This cannot be undone." Should we require typing DELETE, a checkbox, or just a confirm button? rahul: Depends on severity. For config objects that can break runtime, extra friction makes sense. maybe a threshold: if count > 20 or if any of the items are production-scoped, require typing DELETE. otherwise show preview + red primary CTA. liam: microcopy proposals: - Option A: "Delete 3 configs? This will permanently remove these configuration entries. Type DELETE to confirm." - Option B: "Remove 3 configs? This can't be undone." [Cancel] [Delete permanently] Sophia: Prefer A for high-risk deletes. If we ask to type DELETE, ensure the input has aria-label and we move focus to it. Also make the confirm button disabled until text matches exactly. maya: Implementation detail for summary focus: ``` const summary = document.getElementById('form-error-summary'); summary.setAttribute('tabindex','-1'); summary.focus(); ``` and summary should include anchor links like Row 3: missing name with clear link text. liam: sounds good. small nit on delete CTA wording: "Delete permanently" vs "Delete forever" — I'd vote for "Delete permanently" (less sensational). rahul: Also show count in modal title: "Delete 12 configs" not just "Delete items". clearer. sophia: one more accessibility nit: for inline errors rely on aria-describedby on the input to point to the error id so screen readers announce it when focus lands on the field. maya: consensus check: 1) both summary + inline, 2) asterisk ok but include SR text/legend, 3) delete modal: threshold-based extra friction (type DELETE when > threshold or production flag), 4) copy: use "Delete permanently" and explicit counts. any objections? rahul: SGTM liam: +1 aria-bot: reminder: design PR checklist — add "accessibility: error summary focus" item. maya: I'll update Figma and draft modal copy + PR. will ping when ready. thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
